# bloomery

> An LLM inference engine for one workstation. It serves an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API from a local model.

To start the server from an agent, read [docs/agents.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/midagedev/bloomery/main/docs/agents.md). `bloomery-serve --recommend --json` lists what this machine serves, `bloomery-serve --model NAME` starts it, and the `ready` event on stdout says when to send requests.
